tour.title: Application Entry Points
tour.description: The project boots from two ends: the Rust backend (Tauri) and the React frontend. This setup enables high-performance native features with a modern web UI.

tour.title: State & Database Management
tour.description: Backend state is managed in AppState with in-memory caches for instant lookups. Data is persisted across two SQLite databases: one for user content and one for the dictionary.

tour.title: Core Domain: Spaced Repetition (SRS)
tour.description: The heart of the learning experience is the SRS algorithm. It uses an exponential backoff strategy to calculate optimal review intervals across 8 mastery levels.

tour.title: Advanced Features: Decomposition & TTS
tour.description: The application includes sophisticated features like recursive character decomposition and multi-voice Text-to-Speech using Microsoft Edge Neural voices.

tour.title: Frontend State & Features
tour.description: The UI is organized by features (Review, Dashboard, Dictionary). Global state like themes and session data is handled by Zustand stores and custom hooks.
